jobs.description: Home»Jobs»Employment Type»Full Time Jobs»Cybersecurity Trainer Job Mediacrest College, Nairobi, Kenya
responsibilities: Teach networking security, threat analysis, ethical hacking, incident response, and governance
Design and supervise practical labs, simulations, and learner assessments
Guide students on ethical, legal, and professional cybersecurity practice
Keep training materials current with emerging threats, tools, and standards
requirements: Degree or diploma in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
Hands-on experience with security tools, Linux, networking, vulnerability assessment, and incident response
Relevant certifications such as Security+, CEH, CCNA Security, or CISSP are an advantage
Experience facilitating technical training or mentoring learners
Strong communication, documentation, and classroom management skills
